id: title:brittanyjoiner15:include retry time in 429 rate limit error message

review.posthog_relevance: Adds structured metadata and human-readable formatting to rate-limit responses for LLM requests, distinguishing between temporary back-offs and genuine limit resets to prevent users from retrying when no credits are available.
review.reason: The change introduces a helper function and boolean flags to distinguish between temporary back-offs and genuine limit resets in rate-limited LLM requests, while also formatting retry-after delays into human-readable strings. This improves the reliability and usability of error responses without changing core query or ingestion logic.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the implementation and metadata dependency, not on observed systemic benefit or broader impact. No tier 3 systemic benefit or tier 1 narrow maintenance is demonstrated. No tier 3 systemic benefit or tier 1 narrow maintenance is demonstrated.
